title: Capacity decision micro-animations and SLA snapshot screens
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Create a compact set of onboarding visuals and micro-animations that guide new users through Dedicated capacity setup, autoscaling trade-offs, and SLA expectations. Deliverables: (1) Figma file with screens for 'Quick capacity estimate', 'Autoscale policy chooser', 'SLA snapshot card' and micro-animations exported as Lottie + MP4; (2) High-fidelity PNGs for docs and product screenshots; (3) Copy variants for microcopy and tooltips; (4) Handoff tokens and redlines in Figma.
Scope: Focus on first-run onboarding flow only (no billing flows). Accessibility: color-contrast checks and screen-reader labels for all explanatory panels. Localization: prepare English + placeholder keys for i18n. Success metrics: reduce first-run support tickets about capacity by 30% in the pilot customers, and increase completed Dedicated provisioning rate by 12%.
Technical notes: follow Dedicated capacity constraints (single-region, reserved GPUs). Animations must be <= 300KB Lottie or 2s MP4 and loopable. Screenshots must be 1440x900 export with UI chrome blurred for docs where customer org names appear.
Acceptance criteria: Figma file with prototype, exported Lottie/MP4s, 3 PNG screenshots, approved copy doc, and a linked PR to the docs site with screenshots. Design review approval required from PM and Eng leads.

Avoid using the word 'failover' in user-facing copy; prefer 'fallback model/region' wording per legal.
Prototype should include a compact 'why this matters' tooltip for each step — keep copy under 20 words.
